parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the focal length f of a lens. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Place the centre of the lens at a distance u = 20.0 cm from the illuminated object. Place the screen close to the lens and move it away from the lens until a sharply-focused image is formed on the screen. • Measure the distance v from the centre of the lens to the screen. Record v in Table 3.1. • Calculate uv and record the result in the table. • Measure and record in the table the distance D from the illuminated object to the screen. [3]
